results.headline: Half Year Results
results.key_quote: Ecora's strong first-half performance builds on the momentum established in 2025. The core critical minerals portfolio delivered another record performance, further demonstrating its underlying cash generation potential, with revenue growth converting to a significant increase in adjusted earnings growth, highlighting the scalability of the royalty model.
results.summary: Ecora delivered strongly ahead of expectations with record performance across the portfolio. Total portfolio contribution increased 75% to $31.3m, revenue increased 102% to $32.0m, and adjusted earnings surged 509% to $19.5m. The company achieved profit before tax of $24.3m versus a loss of $10.9m in H1 2025. Base metals portfolio contribution more than doubled (159% increase). Free cash flow more than sextupled to $12.1m, enabling net debt reduction and a significant increase in interim dividend to 1.90 cents per share (versus 0.60 cents prior year). CEO commentary explicitly references 'strong first-half performance', 'record performance', and 'strong cash generation', all tied to exceeding prior period results and demonstrating underlying cash generation potential.
metrics_ahead: Profit before tax swing from loss to $24.3m profit
Interim dividend increased 217% to 1.90 cents per share
